summary: HUHUTECH International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its German subsidiary received purchase orders totaling approximately €13.9 million (~US$15.0 million) for high-purity process systems from a European advanced-node semiconductor foundry. The orders were signed between October 2025 and May 2026 and support a new wafer fab in Dresden. No equity, debt, or corporate structure changes are involved—this is a routine customer contract announcement. The contract is part of the company's Global 2026 initiative but does not constitute a special situation. No additional specifics on deal terms, prices, or strategic changes are provided.
